notes.text:
An update is available for kernel-rt.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The kernel-rt packages provide the Real Time Linux Kernel, which enables fine-tuning for systems with extremely high determinism requirements.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: hold event_mutex while checkpointing CRIU events (CVE-2026-74446)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: fix SMI event cross-process information leak (CVE-2026-97422)

* kernel: drm/amd/pm: bound pp_dpm_set_pp_table() memcpy (CVE-2026-97427)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds for allocate_sdma_queue restore_sdma_id (CVE-2026-97497)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: validate and share PSP fw_pri_buf copies via psp_copy_fw (CVE-2026-97494)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds on allocate_doorbell (CVE-2026-97495)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: Bound GPIO I2C table entry count from VBIOS (CVE-2026-97493)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix buffer overflow during vBIOS update (CVE-2026-97425)

* kernel: net/smc: protect clcsock lifetime in smc_getname (CVE-2026-99032)

* kernel: kernel: Denial of Service via use-after-free race condition in SCSI tape driver (CVE-2026-99156)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* soft lockup occurs during iomap_finish_ioends (JIRA:Rocky Linux-258946)

* gfs2: BUG during withdraw [Rocky Linux-8] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-298310)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
